notes.title: Demo and Kickstarter Campaign in the works
notes.content:
Ahoy there, fellow pirates!
There are some major news to announce regarding Time Travel Shanty. 
After working on the game for most of last year I've finally been able to update the store page with the current stage of the game and the new direction of the gameplay, and also released a brand-new trailer with music composed by Tunglith. Also the logo has undergone a bit of a redesign to match the new art direction of the game better. Let me know what you think!

[previewyoutube=0J_ZoSes86M;full][/previewyoutube]
Demo in March
Currently I'm working through nights to get a demo ready for everyone to try out and see what the game is gonna be. The release of the demo will be mid March, so not too far away anymore. Though I will run an internal playtest on my discord a bit before that. So head over there, and get the playtester role to have a chance to try it out before everyone else! And don't be shy if you got any questions or ideas!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40849313/9daa8449af45190638cab6d48552b6d581e71885.jpg
Kickstarter Pre-Launch Page
Next to all of that I've also set up the pre-launch page of the kickstarter campaign that I want to run later this year. It would mean a lot if you could head over to the page and press the 'Notify me on launch' button. It doesn't cost a thing and will just send you an E-mail once the campaign starts, like a wishlist here on Steam.

Thank you so much for your support!
